paper.title: ClimateSet: A Large-Scale Climate Model Dataset for Machine Learning
paper.authors: Julia Kaltenborn, Charlotte E. E. Lange, Venkatesh Ramesh et al.

thesis: We believe ClimateSet will create the basis needed for the ML community to tackle climate-related tasks at scale.

reconstruction.scope: abstract-level graph with retained full text

nodes.title: Research question
nodes.body: How can the target scientific task be compared under fixed data and evaluation rules?

nodes.title: Freeze tasks and metrics
nodes.body: Many of those tasks have been addressed on datasets created with single climate models.

nodes.title: Evaluate reference systems
nodes.body: However, both the climate science and ML communities have suggested that to address those tasks at scale, we need large, consistent, and ML-ready climate model datasets.

nodes.title: Primary reported result
nodes.body: We showcase the potential of our dataset by using it as a benchmark for ML-based climate model emulation.

nodes.title: Published conclusion
nodes.body: We believe ClimateSet will create the basis needed for the ML community to tackle climate-related tasks at scale.
